# Resources: Typography

Open font sources with clear licences, commercial foundries worth knowing, type seen in real use, tools, the guides that matter, and a full section for Chinese type and typesetting.

Access reads `cost · agent access · licence`. Agent access: `static` = a plain web fetch can read it; `js` = needs a real browser; `blocked` = bot protection or a login wall, send the user the link instead; `unknown` = could not be reached from the maintainer's network when last checked (not proof that it is down). `login` = content is gated. Tier: `S` first place to look, `A` strong, `B` niche or with a clear weakness.

## Open and free font sources

The route away from default typefaces without licence risk. Self-host; do not hot-link.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com) | The largest open font library, with variable fonts, language filters and an API | Filter by language and variable axes; self-host via Fontsource rather than hot-linking | free · js · Mostly SIL OFL; some Apache-2.0 | S |
| [Fontshare](https://www.fontshare.com) | Professional-grade free fonts from Indian Type Foundry (Satoshi, General Sans, Clash, Cabinet Grotesk) | The fastest way out of the Inter/Roboto default; read the licence page once | free · js · ITF Free Font License: free for commercial use; no redistribution or resale | S |
| [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) | Self-hostable open fonts as npm packages with an API | npm i @fontsource-variable/<name>; API at api.fontsource.org/v1/fonts | free · static · Each font keeps its own open licence | S |
| [Uncut](https://uncut.wtf) | Catalogue of contemporary free typefaces with character | Filter by style; verify each font's licence link | free · blocked · Licence per font, mostly OFL | A |
| [Velvetyne](https://velvetyne.fr) | Libre foundry of expressive, experimental display faces | For posters and identities that need a voice | free · static · SIL OFL | A |
| [Open Foundry](https://open-foundry.com) | Curated open-source typefaces presented well | Quality over quantity | free · static · Open licences per font · slow | A |
| [Use & Modify](https://usemodify.com) | Personal selection of beautiful, classy, punk libre fonts | Good source of unusual open fonts | free · static · Open licences per font | A |
| [The League of Moveable Type](https://www.theleagueofmoveabletype.com) | The original open-source type foundry (League Gothic, Raleway origins) | Reliable classics | free · static · SIL OFL · slow | A |
| [Collletttivo](https://www.collletttivo.it) | Italian open-source type collective | Distinctive display and text faces | free · static · SIL OFL | A |
| [Free Faces](https://www.freefaces.gallery) | Curated gallery of free typefaces from around the web | Check personal-only versus commercial use per font | free · static · Licences vary per font; read each | A |
| [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) | The workhorse UI typeface; excellent, and the most over-used default | Use deliberately, with its OpenType features (tnum, cv11, ss03), not by reflex | free · static · SIL OFL | A |
| [IBM Plex](https://github.com/IBM/plex) | Sans, serif, mono and condensed superfamily with wide language coverage including CJK | A one-family system for products needing mono and serif companions | free · static · SIL OFL | A |
| [Geist](https://vercel.com/font) | Vercel's sans and mono for developer products | Popular in dev tooling; becoming a default of its own | free · static · SIL OFL | A |
| [Monaspace](https://monaspace.githubnext.com) | Five-voice monospace superfamily with texture healing | For code-centric interfaces | free · static · SIL OFL | A |
| [Atkinson Hyperlegible](https://www.brailleinstitute.org/freefont/) | Typeface designed for low-vision legibility with unambiguous letterforms | Use where accessibility is the primary constraint | free · unknown · SIL OFL | A |
| [Noto](https://fonts.google.com/noto) | Harmonised families for nearly every script | Fallback for multilingual products | free · js · SIL OFL | A |
| [google-webfonts-helper](https://gwfh.mranftl.com/fonts) | Download Google Fonts files with ready @font-face CSS for self-hosting | Pick only needed weights and subsets | free · js | A |

## Commercial foundries and marketplaces

Trial and free-to-try files are for mock-ups only and must not ship.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Klim Type Foundry](https://klim.co.nz) | Soehne, Tiempos, National: benchmark contemporary text and grotesque families | Test fonts may not ship | paid · static · Commercial; free test fonts for mock-ups only | A |
| [Grilli Type](https://www.grillitype.com) | GT America, GT Walsheim and richly documented mini-sites per family | Study the specimen mini-sites | paid · static · Commercial; free trial fonts | A |
| [Commercial Type](https://commercialtype.com) | Editorial heavyweights (Graphik, Canela, Publico) | Reference for editorial pairings | paid · js · Commercial | A |
| [ABC Dinamo](https://abcdinamo.com) | Contemporary variable families (Diatype, Favorit, Whyte) and tools | Trend-defining; expect to see them widely | paid · static · Commercial; trials on request | A |
| [Pangram Pangram](https://pangrampangram.com) | Fashion-forward families that are free to try | A common licensing trap: personal-use files must not ship commercially | freemium · static · Free for personal use; commercial licence required | A |
| [OH no Type Co.](https://ohnotype.co) | Expressive display faces and an excellent type-design blog | Read the blog for drawing and spacing lessons | paid · static · Commercial | A |
| [Future Fonts](https://www.futurefonts.com) | Marketplace for in-progress typefaces bought early at lower prices | Source of fresh faces few others use | paid · js · Commercial, early-access pricing | A |
| [Typotheque](https://www.typotheque.com) | Multi-script specialist with serious research articles | Read /articles for multilingual typography | paid · static · Commercial | A |
| [Adobe Fonts](https://fonts.adobe.com) | Large commercial library bundled with Creative Cloud | Web use only through Adobe's embed | paid · static · login · Included with Creative Cloud; no self-hosting; client projects need the client's own subscription | A |
| [Fontstand](https://fontstand.com) | Try commercial fonts free for an hour and rent them monthly | Test a commercial face in a real layout before buying | paid · static · login · Rental licences | A |
| [YouWorkForThem](https://www.youworkforthem.com) | Independent shop for fonts and graphic assets (display faces, vector shape packs, textures) | Useful for distinctive display type and Y2K-style vector packs | paid · static · Perpetual licences, no subscription | B |

## Type in use and pairing

See a typeface set in real context before choosing it.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Fonts In Use](https://fontsinuse.com) | Archive of typography in real use, indexed by typeface, format and industry | Search a typeface to see it set in context; search an industry to see its conventions | free · static | S |
| [Typewolf](https://www.typewolf.com) | Type on real websites, plus trusted lists: best fonts by category and free alternatives to commercial faces | Use the alternatives lists when a commercial face is out of budget; /cheatsheet for typographic punctuation | free · unknown | S |
| [Beautiful Web Type](https://beautifulwebtype.com) | Showcase of the best open-source typefaces set beautifully | Shortlist of open fonts worth using | free · js · slow | A |
| [Variable Fonts](https://v-fonts.com) | Catalogue of variable fonts with live axis sliders | Test axes before choosing | free · unknown | A |
| [Fontjoy](https://fontjoy.com) | Machine-learned font pairing generator | Idea generator only; judge pairings by eye | free · static · slow | B |

## Type tools

Scales, fluid type, system stacks, inspection, metrics and subsetting.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Utopia](https://utopia.fyi) | Fluid type and space scales that interpolate between a small and a large viewport, output as CSS clamp() | Define min and max scale, copy the custom properties | free · static | S |
| [Modern Font Stacks](https://modernfontstacks.com) | System font stacks by typographic classification, no web fonts needed | Copy a stack for zero-cost, native-feeling type | free · static · CC0 | S |
| [Wakamai Fondue](https://wakamaifondue.com) | Drop a font to see its features, axes, languages and ready CSS | Check what a font can do before designing with it | free · js | S |
| [Typescale](https://typescale.com) | Visual type-scale calculator with live preview and export | Compare ratios with the real typeface | free · static | A |
| [Capsize](https://seek-oss.github.io/capsize/) | Trims text boxes to cap height and baseline using font metrics | Use until text-box-trim is universally available | free · static · MIT | A |
| [Fallback font generator](https://screenspan.net/fallback) | Generates metric overrides so a fallback font matches the web font and avoids layout shift | Paste the result into the @font-face for the fallback | free · static | A |
| [glyphhanger](https://github.com/zachleat/glyphhanger) | Finds the glyphs a site uses and subsets fonts accordingly | Use for Latin subsetting in build pipelines | free · static · MIT · slow | A |
| [WhatTheFont](https://www.myfonts.com/pages/whatthefont) | Identify a typeface from an image | First step of a style-DNA extraction from a screenshot | free · static | A |

## Typography guides

Read the first two in full once.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Practical Typography](https://practicaltypography.com) | Butterick's web book: the most useful typography rules per minute of reading | Read Typography in ten minutes and Summary of key rules | free · static | S |
| [Google Fonts Knowledge](https://fonts.google.com/knowledge) | Structured lessons on choosing, pairing and using type, including variable fonts | Look up a topic (pairing, legibility, OpenType features) | free · js | S |
| [Thinking with Type](https://thinkingwithtype.com) | Ellen Lupton's primer on letter, text and grid, with online lessons | Read the Grid chapter before any layout-heavy graphic | free · unknown | S |
| [The Elements of Typographic Style Applied to the Web](https://webtypography.net) | Bringhurst's principles translated into CSS | Reference for rhythm and proportion rules | free · js · archived | A |
| [Better Web Type](https://betterwebtype.com) | Web typography course and articles for developers | Short, practical lessons | freemium · static · slow | A |
| [Pimp my Type](https://pimpmytype.com) | Font reviews, pairing and UI-typography advice | Look up font-of-the-week reviews for well-judged open fonts | free · static | A |
| [Web Design is 95% Typography](https://ia.net/topics/the-web-is-all-about-typography-period) | The classic argument that treating text as UI is most of web design | Read once | free · static · archived | A |
| [web.dev: font best practices](https://web.dev/articles/font-best-practices) | Font loading, preloading, subsetting and font-display strategy | Follow when adding any web font | free · static | A |

## Chinese type and typesetting

Open-licence Chinese fonts, licence directories, web-font slicing, and the typesetting rules for punctuation and mixed scripts. Commercial Chinese font licensing is actively enforced.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Source Han Sans / Serif (思源黑体 / 宋体) (zh)](https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-han-sans) | The open pan-CJK standard in seven weights; identical to Noto Sans / Serif CJK | Default open choice for Chinese text; ship subsetted or sliced | free · static · SIL OFL | S |
| [Alibaba PuHuiTi (阿里巴巴普惠体) (zh)](https://www.alibabafonts.com) | Modern Chinese sans in many weights with Latin companions | Download from the official site to keep the licence record | free · js · login · Free for commercial use under Alibaba's licence terms; no resale of the font files | S |
| [猫啃网 (zh)](https://www.maoken.com) | Directory of free-for-commercial Chinese fonts with licence evidence for each | Check here before using any Chinese font found elsewhere | free · static | S |
| [中文网字计划 (zh)](https://chinese-font.netlify.app) | Sliced Chinese web fonts over CDN plus cn-font-split to slice your own | Makes Chinese web fonts practical by loading only used unicode ranges | free · static · Apache-2.0 tooling; fonts keep their own licences | S |
| [Requirements for Chinese Text Layout (中文排版需求) (zh)](https://www.w3.org/TR/clreq/) | The W3C reference for Chinese typesetting: punctuation, line breaking, mixed-script spacing, emphasis, vertical text | Look up the rule before arguing about punctuation or line-start prohibitions | free · blocked | S |
| [中文文案排版指北 (zh)](https://github.com/sparanoid/chinese-copywriting-guidelines) | Widely adopted conventions for spacing, punctuation and proper nouns in Chinese copy | Adopt one convention per product and lint for it | free · static · MIT | S |
| [The Type (zh)](https://www.thetype.com) | The most serious Chinese-language writing on type and typesetting, including the Kongque punctuation research | Read Kongque for punctuation width and spacing behaviour | free · js | S |
| [HarmonyOS Sans (zh)](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/design/resource/) | Huawei's system typeface covering Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Latin and more | Use for HarmonyOS apps and as a neutral UI face | free · js · Free commercial use under the HarmonyOS Sans licence agreement | A |
| [MiSans (zh)](https://hyperos.mi.com/font/) | Xiaomi's variable Chinese sans with wide weight range | Variable weights suit fluid UI hierarchies | free · js · Free commercial use under Xiaomi's licence agreement | A |
| [Smiley Sans (得意黑) (zh)](https://github.com/atelier-anchor/smiley-sans) | Open-source condensed oblique Chinese display face with real character | Headlines only | free · static · SIL OFL | A |
| [LXGW WenKai (霞鹜文楷) (zh)](https://github.com/lxgw/LxgwWenKai) | Open-source Kai-style face for warm, literary reading text | For editorial and humanistic tone | free · static · SIL OFL | A |
| [赫蹏 (heti) (zh)](https://github.com/sivan/heti) | CSS typesetting enhancement for Chinese content: punctuation squeezing, mixed-script spacing, rhythm | Use on article bodies | free · static · MIT · slow | A |
| [pangu.js (zh)](https://github.com/vinta/pangu.js) | Automatically inserts spacing between CJK and half-width characters | Prefer fixing copy at the source; use for user-generated text | free · static · MIT | A |
| [AutoCorrect (zh)](https://github.com/huacnlee/autocorrect) | Linter and formatter for CJK copy: spacing, punctuation, full-width rules | Put it in CI to keep product copy consistent | free · static · MIT | A |
| [方正字库 (zh)](https://www.foundertype.com) | China's largest commercial type library | Never use FounderType or Hanyi fonts commercially without a purchased licence | paid · static · login · Commercial licence required per use; enforcement is active | B |
